content: My "Y" cable did not have even remotely enough slack to route the cable and cable tie.  Had to temporarily unplug it from the board and feed a little slack back up, route the cable and zip tie it, put the motor back into place and then reconnect the Y connector to the board.

If also doing the INDX conversion, the guide states the bowden guide isn't used any longer so I removed the nut. (Push the end of a zip tie through the screw hole to slide the nut out a little, then grab the nut with needle nose pliers to remove.)
Isn't that an M3nS nut?  Not M3nN?
Please add that you need to cut the excess portion of the zip tie.
